newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ student loan interest rate drops to 8.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ student loan interest rate drops to 8.2 pct.

text.p: Revenue Minister Bill Birch and Education Minister Wyatt Creech on Wednesday announced the Student Loan Scheme interest rate will drop to 8.2 percent from 8.4 percent, effective April 1, 1997.
The ministers said the two components of the interest rate were a base rate of 5.9 percent plus the interest adjustment, which reflects movements in the Consumers Price Index, of 2.3 percent.
The repayment threshold will rise to NZ$14,560 from $14,300.
